youtube.title: Pironman 5 vs Pironman 5-MAX: Which Raspberry Pi 5 Case? #shorts
youtube.description:
Pironman 5 ($79.99) or Pironman 5-MAX ($94.99)? One NVMe slot vs two with RAID 0/1. Full comparison: https://wisechoicekr.com/best/sunfounder-pironman-5-vs-pironman-5-max/

Prices from SunFounder's store at the time of recording. Based on published specs and store info, not hands-on testing. Raspberry Pi, SSD and power supply not included.

scenes.title: Pironman 5 vs Pironman 5-MAX
scenes.say: Pironman 5, or Pironman 5 MAX? Here's the difference in under a minute.

scenes.title: Both turn a Raspberry Pi 5 into a mini PC
scenes.say: Both cases turn a Raspberry Pi 5 into a mini PC, with a tower cooler, two RGB fans, a small OLED status screen, full size HDMI ports and a safe shutdown power button.

scenes.title: One NVMe slot
scenes.say: The Pironman 5 costs seventy nine ninety nine and has one NVMe slot. That's plenty for a desktop, a media center or a Home Assistant hub.

scenes.title: Two NVMe slots + RAID
scenes.say: The 5 MAX costs ninety four ninety nine and has two NVMe slots with RAID zero and one. Build a two drive NAS, or run an SSD and a Hailo AI accelerator together.

scenes.title: Not in the box
scenes.say: Heads up. Neither case includes the Raspberry Pi, the SSD or a power supply, and SunFounder lists some SSDs that don't work. Check before you buy.

scenes.title:
1 drive → Pironman 5
2 drives → 5-MAX
scenes.say: One drive? Get the Pironman 5. Two drives? Get the MAX. Full comparison on WiseChoice K R dot com.
